dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Glory... Please wait for me a little longer, I swear I'll become someone you can be proud of...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Ah... Hello, Honorary Knight. I'm observing my daily repentance.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: After the Grand Master dispatched me to Nod-Krai, this has become part of my routine. This way, I won't forget why I came here.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: If I don't keep this up, I'm worried I'll sink back into endless procrastination, then lose the courage to shoulder my responsibilities and the resolve to confess my love.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: The Grand Master helped me fight for this final chance. I must make up for the expedition I missed and prove myself a true knight!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright...?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: *sigh*... I'm sorry for the trouble I caused you and the Grand Master. Just thinking about how I behaved back then... I wish I could give myself a slap in the face!

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: How did I not understand? The only way to make up for my mistakes was to make Glory happy.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: If neither lies nor truths could do that... I should have seen that there was only one thing left for me to do — become someone capable of giving her happiness.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the "expedition" going?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: It's only after coming to Nod-Krai that I've truly begun to understand what I missed out on.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: It's not like I've been idle these past few years, but compared to those brave knights in the expedition party who faced countless challenges in the ice and snow, I really am too weak.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Whether it's combat skills or knightly chivalry, I can't keep lagging behind the rest!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Farewell, Honorary Knight. May Vennessa watch over you.

dialogues.text: These are some things I picked up from the others. They might not seem like much to you, but I'll share them with you anyway!
